item.title: Investigation Report: Psy Protocol
item.author: yrong1997@gmail.com (Ronyang)
item.description:
Project Overview & Background

Psy Protocol (formerly known as QED Protocol) is a trustless, horizontally scalable Layer-1 blockchain and ZK-rollup network1, 2. Founded by Carter Jack Feldman, the project has secured substantial backing from prominent venture capital firms including Blockchain Capital, Arrington Capital, StarkWare, and Anagram1, 3. Its core mission is to enable internet-scale throughput for Web3 applications (such as high-frequency orderbook exchanges and agentic AI payments) while inheriting the base-layer security of Proof-of-Work networks like Bitcoin and Dogecoin2, 4, 5.
